Cloverdale real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.q: What is this page — a neighbourhood guide or an index?
faq.a: An index. The page, headed "The three Cloverdale areas," links one guide for each Cloverdale MLS® area — Cloverdale BC, Clayton and Serpentine — each covering schools, parks, planning and what to check before buying, and it carries no single-neighbourhood profile of its own.

faq.q: What did the Cloverdale community market do in September 2026?
faq.a: Community context only (this hub has no market of its own): detached recorded 201 active listings, 32 solds, a $1,212,500 median and 19 days on market, and Condos & Townhomes recorded 194 listings, 37 solds, a $740,000 median and 32 days (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which of the three areas moved fastest in September 2026?
faq.a: Clayton, in both splits — a 29% detached sales ratio (34 listings, 10 solds) and a 21% Condos & Townhomes ratio (96 listings, 20 solds), ahead of the Cloverdale sub-area's 13% and 17%; Serpentine recorded 0 listings and 0 sales in both splits (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Cloverdale?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
